maria: Heads-up — I sketched a migration plan for the new prefetch consistency contract. want quick sanity check before i turn it into an RFC.

alex: dropping the sketch now. TL;DR?

maria: goal is to ensure no read-after-write regressions during handoff between owners + make evict fast-path non-disruptive. plan: dual-read-safe prefix markers + soft-drain lease, with an async reconciler that fixes drift.

kai: dual-read-safe prefix markers = you mean a tombstone-ish tag on a moved prefix so readers know to check the old owner? curious about perf cost.

maria: exactly. marker is tiny (1 byte flag + epoch) stored in the prefix metadata. runtime checks only on misses or lease-change events. should be rare in steady state.

jordan: what about hotkey churn? if a prefix flips owners frequently, markers + reconciler could blow up. any mitigation?

maria: mitigation: 1) short-lived markers expire quickly (TTL tied to lease window), 2) bump to probabilistic sampling: only run the heavy reconciler when we see repeated flip signals, 3) cap retries per-tenant.

alex: outline of the handoff flow?

maria: flow:
```
1) new node requests ownership -> leader grants soft-lease (drainable)
2) old owner marks prefix with marker(epoch=N, drain=true)
3) old owner starts serving reads but rejects mutations after drain=started
4) new owner warms via dual-read (read from marker -> check old owner if mismatch)
5) once KV residency low and no inflight writes, old releases lease -> marker removed
6) reconciler sweeps markers older than TTL and repairs missing k/v if needed
```

kai: sounds reasonable. question: how do we prevent split-brain if leader restarts mid-handoff?

maria: we require lease token CAS in the metastore. if leader restarts, CAS fails and new leader can detect in-progress marker epoch mismatch and either extend drain or abort handoff. markers include owner-id + epoch so detection is easy.

jordan: ops-bot: we should surface telemetry. what metrics would help us run this safely in prod?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: suggested metrics -> `prefix_handoff_start`, `prefix_handoff_fail`, `prefetch_dual_reads`, `marker_created`, `marker_swept`, `handoff_duration_ms`, `hotflip_rate_per_prefix`. alert on handoff_fail spikes and hotflip_rate > threshold. :bell:

alex: action items: maria -> turn this into RFC with failure-mode matrix; kai -> prototype marker encode in in-memory header; jordan -> ops playbook for reconciler (timeouts/kill-switch). I'll take perf microbench for dual-read path.

maria: thanks. i'll write RFC draft by EOD and ping the runtime channel. any other blocking concerns?

kai: just one: ensure we don't change client-visible semantics (no lost writes). otherwise go for it.

maria: agreed. will include thorough regression tests and a chaos plan. :thumbsup:
